game.title: Far Cry 4
game.blurb: Open-world first-person shooter set in Kyrat, from Ubisoft Montreal, published by Ubisoft Entertainment, released 2014-11-18. RAWG average playtime: 17 hours. Genre: Shooter. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Joining the Golden Path, discovering Shangri-La and deciding the fates of the four named rulers.

chapters.title: Outposts, Bell Towers and Fortresses
chapters.summary: Liberating outposts and bell towers, conquering fortresses, and stopping convoys, cargo trucks and retaliation parties.

chapters.title: Quests and Activities
chapters.summary: Hunting, Assassination, Hostage Rescue, Bomb Defusal, Kyrati Films and Kyrat Fashion Week quests, the Arena and Guns For Hire.

chapters.title: Collectibles and the Homestead
chapters.summary: Masks of Yalung, propaganda posters, lost letters, Mani wheels, notes and the Ghale Homestead.

chapters.title: Skills, Crafting and Shopping
chapters.summary: Learning skills, crafting upgrades and syringes, and spending rupees on weapons.

chapters.title: Combat and Getting Around
chapters.summary: Kills with elephants, fire, mortars, arrows and explosives, takedowns, the camera, driving and the wingsuit.

chapters.title: Co-op and Online
chapters.summary: Campaign co-op, Battles of Kyrat matches and the Map Browser.

chapters.title: Valley of the Yetis
chapters.summary: The Relay Station, its upgrade quests, the yetis and finishing the Valley of the Yetis campaign.

attribution: Achievement data from Steam (Steam Web API, app 298110)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/Far_Cry_4
Fandom (farcry.fandom.com, CC BY-SA): page names only were checked to confirm structure; no text copied — https://farcry.fandom.com/wiki/Far_Cry_4
notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3497). Steam app 298110 ("Far Cry® 4") was used. StrategyWiki has no page under "Far Cry 4" or "Far Cry IV". farcry.fandom.com answers the API under "Far Cry 4" with about 216 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. None of the 57 Steam achievements is hidden; the schema skips numbers 4, 6 and 53. Seven achievements say "Valley Of The Yetis", which matches the RAWG add-on "Far Cry 4: Valley of the Yetis", so they get their own chapter; RAWG also lists "Escape from Durgesh Prison" and "Hurk Deluxe", but no achievement names them ("Brother In Arms" names Hurk in campaign co-op and sits in co-op). "The People's Champ" (Arena Rank 5) sits with the quests. The story achievements do not say in which order the fates are decided, so the story is one chapter.
